input_scenario.title: Input scenario
input_scenario.description: How GCtree is invoked: aligned FASTA (or FASTA from tabular adapter), DNAPARS outfile + abundances bundle (see upload guidance), or GCtree forest pickle re-ranking.

doMapping.title: Enable input column mapping
doMapping.description: When true and a CSV/TSV input is selected, map source table headers to canonical GCtree tabular keys before conversion.

column_map.title: Input Column Mapping
column_map.description: Map canonical GCtree tabular keys to source table columns.

germline_row_present.title: Does your table already include the germline / root row?
germline_row_present.description: GCtree needs a germline (root / outgroup) sequence in the alignment it infers from. Yes — the row is already in your table, so just name it below. No — the framework adds it for you from the ID and sequence you provide below, writing one extra row into the table before converting it to FASTA.

root.title: Root sequence ID
root.description: Original uploaded ID of the germline / outgroup sequence in the input FASTA alignment (FASTA-derived scenarios). It may be remapped internally to a short PHYLIP/GCtree-safe ID.

root_sequence_id.title: Root sequence ID to add
root_sequence_id.description: Identifier for the germline row the framework will add. It is written into your table's sequence_id column — or into whichever column you mapped that key to — and becomes the FASTA header GCtree roots on.

root_sequence_alignment.title: Root (germline) aligned sequence
root_sequence_alignment.description: Aligned germline sequence for the row the framework will add, written into your table's sequence_alignment column (or the column you mapped that key to). It joins the same alignment as the other sequences, so its length must equal theirs — gap characters included.

at_abundance.title: Does the number after “@” mean abundance?
at_abundance.description: Your FASTA headers look like name@N (for example seq3@9). GCtree writes this form in its own output but cannot read it back, and the “@” also breaks the DNAPARS root lookup. Yes — treat N as the number of times that sequence was observed and build the abundance counts from it. No — the “@” is part of the name, so the IDs are replaced with short GCtree-safe IDs (the originals stay in the ID map).

frame.title: Coding frame (1–3)
frame.description: Reading frame for amino-acid mutation annotation in GCtree (GCtree CLI --frame).

frame2.title: Coding frame for second chain (advanced)
frame2.description: When set, passed as --frame2 to GCtree for paired-chain workflows.

chain_split.title: Chain split (advanced)
chain_split.description: When greater than 0, passed as --chain_split to GCtree.

apply_isotype.title: Add isotype annotation/rendering
apply_isotype.description: After a successful inference, run the GCtree isotype utility when idmap and isotype map files are provided (zip bundle). This can change tree rendering when resolving isotype conflicts; it is not simple coloring.

top_n.title: Number of trees to return
top_n.description: Maximum top ranked trees to extract from GCtree output. GCtree normally renders/ranks a limited set of representative top trees.

ranking_strategy.title: Ranking strategy expression
ranking_strategy.description: GCtree ranking expression using non-experimental/simple criteria only: B = branching process log loss, A = number of alleles, R = sitewise reversions to the naive/root sequence. Lexicographic examples: B,A or B,R,A. Linear examples: B+0.01A or B+0.1R+0.01A. Experimental criteria I, C, and M are not accepted.

quick.title: Quick parsimony search
quick.description: If true, pass --quick to mkconfig/dnapars for a faster but less exhaustive parsimony search.

jumble.title: DNAPARS jumble replicates
jumble.description: If set, pass --jumble N to mkconfig so DNAPARS searches N random permutations of the input sequences.

img_type.title: Image file type
img_type.description: Image format for GCtree output figures (CLI --img_type).

outbase.title: Output basename
outbase.description: Basename for GCtree outputs (CLI --outbase). Files like '<outbase>.inference.1.svg' will be created.

idlabel.title: Label nodes with sequence IDs
idlabel.description: Pass --idlabel so tree images are labeled with unique sequence IDs and a FASTA alignment of inferred sequences is written.

show_nucleotide_mutations.title: Show nucleotide mutations on branches
show_nucleotide_mutations.description: If true, pass --show_nucleotide_mutations to annotate rendered trees with nucleotide changes.

summarize_forest.title: Summarize forest
summarize_forest.description: If true, pass --summarize_forest and write a forest summary log for all trees in the parsimony forest.

tree_stats.title: Compute detailed tree statistics
tree_stats.description: If true, pass --tree_stats and generate per-tree statistics and pairplot figures (can be slow for large forests).

color_mode.title: Coloring mode
color_mode.description: Extra simplified coloring on the top-ranked GCtree tree: abundance (linear, viridis) or local branching index LBI (log, viridis). none skips extra colored render.
